subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four guard repairs and final-head validation, should OpenClaw approve these revised third-party actions for its privileged workflows?
rationale: Pin and compatibility checks are deterministic, but accepting changed executable code at secret, token, security-upload, publishing, and agent boundaries requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Approve after validation
options.body: Repair the guards, rebase, pass the focused checks, and accept the verified immutable revisions.

options.title: Split sensitive revisions
options.body: Remove any privileged action update that does not receive owner acceptance and land only the approved subset.

recommendation.title: Approve after validation
recommendation.body: Repair the guards, rebase, pass the focused checks, and accept the verified immutable revisions.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent individual history across the central workflow surfaces; secops team approval is additionally required for its CODEOWNERS paths.
